responsibility: Implements the selective scheduler’s internal IR and region/CFG support layer. It owns region and basic-block metadata, list and pool allocators, fence/boundary/ilist utilities, nop and regset pools, virtual-insn construction and copying, data-set maintenance for availability and liveness, selective-scheduling-specific CFG editing hooks, and loop-preheader/region preparation used for pipelining. This file supplies the internal representation and structural services on which sel-sched.cc’s algorithm operates.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation source for selective scheduling’s internal IR and structural support, including region/basic-block metadata, pools, lists, data-set maintenance, and CFG/pipelining helpers. The same-stem header gcc/sel-sched-ir.h defines the private IR types, macros, and service declarations that describe that infrastructure.
